+
+print("Initial cache stats:", pp.ParserElement.packrat_cache_stats)
+print("Cache type:", type(pp.ParserElement.packrat_cache))
+print("_parse method:", pp.ParserElement._parse)
+print("_parseCache method:", pp.ParserElement._parseCache)
+
+# Let's manually inspect what happens during parsing
+# We'll override the _parseCache method to add some debug info
+
+original_parseCache = pp.ParserElement._parseCache
+
+def debug_parseCache(self, instring, loc, do_actions=True, callPreParse=True):
+    print(f"DEBUG: In debug_parseCache")
+    lookup = (self, instring, loc, callPreParse, do_actions)
+    print(f"Parsing with key: {lookup}")
+    
+    with pp.ParserElement.packrat_cache_lock:
+        cache = pp.ParserElement.packrat_cache
+        value = cache.get(lookup)
+        print(f"Cache lookup result: {value}")
+        print(f"Value is not_in_cache: {value is cache.not_in_cache}")
+        
+        result = original_parseCache(self, instring, loc, do_actions, callPreParse)
+        # Check cache again after parsing
+        value_after = cache.get(lookup)
+        print(f"Cache after parsing: {value_after}")
+        print(f"Value after is not_in_cache: {value_after is cache.not_in_cache}")
+        return result
+
+pp.ParserElement._parseCache = debug_parseCache
+
+# Also override _parse to make sure it goes through our debug version

+
